title: fix: add ?raw module declaration to test environment
author: samucamg
pr_body_excerpt:
Supersedes #14397.

- Declares wildcard module for `*?raw` static imports in `enter.pollinations.ai/test/env.d.ts`.
- Prevents TypeScript compiler errors when importing raw SQL or static assets in tests.
- Keeps the change isolated to 5 lines without unrelated changes.

Co-authored-by: Karan Ray <karanray06@users.noreply.github.com>

gist.headline: Raw imports, no buzzing
gist.blurb: The test hive now recognizes `?raw` imports without stopping to argue with TypeScript. Five small lines, one less compiler tantrum.
gist.summary: Added a wildcard `*?raw` module declaration to `enter.pollinations.ai/test/env.d.ts`, allowing tests to statically import raw SQL and assets without TypeScript compiler errors.
gist.impact: Contributors can add raw-file test fixtures such as SQL or static assets with `?raw` imports and get clean TypeScript checks.
gist.visual_concept: Polli, wearing tiny librarian glasses, files a glowing raw SQL scroll into a cozy test-environment cabinet while a small CRT monitor robot happily confirms the import. Code-plants and a few pixel flowers make the internal tooling scene feel cared for rather than bureaucratic.
